sectionOrder: Public shop, spawn, and map items

item.name: Soda
item.source: Vending machines or separate shop Soda purchase
item.price: $5 from vending machines or the shop Soda purchase
item.effect: Drinks Soda to restore HP and evasion; under 25 HP, the user crushes the can and can throw it with M1.
item.damageHeal: Restores HP and evasion to full over a few seconds; regeneration stops if the user is attacked.
item.usesBreakRule: Consumed after drinking; the low-HP thrown can can be picked up and thrown repeatedly until it despawns.
item.storageDropDespawn: Can be carried or stored by Ten Shadows before use; thrown cans follow pickup and despawn behavior.
item.location: Vending machines and shop Soda purchase route

item.name: Jet Black
item.source: Shop item delivery or timed map spawns
item.price: $10 through shop item delivery when available
item.effect: Replaces M1 attacks with dagger slashes and knocks enemies back on the final slash.
item.damageHeal: Regular M1 string damage; final slash adds knockback
item.usesBreakRule: Reusable while held
item.storageDropDespawn: Can be stored by Ten Shadows; drops when the holder is hit and despawns if left unclaimed.
item.location: Shop item delivery pool and map item spawns

item.source: Shop item delivery or timed map spawns
item.price: $10 through shop item delivery when available
